intro: Captain Garran Vimes says deserters have settled into a tower that Theramore had abandoned. The tower stands at Lost Point, which lies southeast of the inn. A man called Jacken leads the deserters, and Vimes wants information about Reethe from him.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It has been a struggle maintaining a presence in the marsh, but through strength of our resolve, we have been able to maintain several defensive watchtowers throughout the area.
The latest information and scouting reports I have received indicate that a group of deserters has squatted in our abandoned tower at Lost Point, southeast of the inn.
The deserters' leader is a man named Jacken. See if you can get some information out of him.
Be warned, friend. He may be a tough nut to crack.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Did Vimes send you? Couldn't do his dirty work himself, could he...
